description: The one list of deployment parameters. The chat setup, the command line and the GitHub Actions form all read it, and each parameter maps onto a Terraform variable in a stage. Format: schema/README.md.

phases.title: Discover
phases.summary: What you want to run: environment and identity model.

phases.title: Prepare
phases.summary: Later: read-only readiness checks (roles, providers, region, quota, tools). No parameters.

phases.title: Configure
phases.summary: Names, network, users, hosts and the profile share. Writes the tfvars.

phases.title: Bootstrap
phases.summary: Later: the one admin step that creates the deployment identity and state.

phases.title: Deploy
phases.summary: Later: plan, an explicit yes, then apply.

phases.title: First-run steps
phases.summary: Later: the tenant steps Terraform can't do, such as admin consent for the profile share's Entra app.

phases.title: Verify
phases.summary: Later: post-deploy checks and a first sign-in.

parameters.question: Is this a sandbox, a dev environment or production?
parameters.help: Sets the environment tag. Production should run through the Actions approval gate.

choices.label: Sandbox: try it out, tear it down

parameters.question: How will the session hosts join a directory?
parameters.help: Entra-joined needs no domain controllers and uses Entra Kerberos for the FSLogix share. It is the only model the kit builds for now.

choices.label: Entra Domain Services
choices.reason: Domain join for session hosts comes in a later phase.

choices.label: Active Directory Domain Services (hybrid)
choices.reason: Domain join and the AzFilesHybrid step come in a later phase.

parameters.question: Entra tenant
parameters.help: Read from the signed-in account, never asked or saved.

parameters.question: Subscription
parameters.help: Read from the signed-in account, never asked or saved.

parameters.question: Which Azure region?
parameters.help: Pick the region closest to your users; AVD latency follows distance to the session hosts.

parameters.question: Which availability zones should hosts spread over?
parameters.help: Leave empty in a region without zones. With zones, the NAT IP is zone-redundant and the profile share ZRS.

parameters.question: Short name prefix for resources?
parameters.help: 2-13 lowercase letters, digits or single hyphens, for example avd-dev. Every resource name starts from it.

parameters.question: Address space for the AVD virtual network?
parameters.help: Must not overlap your other networks if you peer to a hub or on-premises.

parameters.question: Subnet for the session hosts?
parameters.help: One address per host; a /22 leaves room for about 1000.

parameters.question: Subnet for private endpoints?
parameters.help: Holds the profile share and Key Vault endpoints.

parameters.question: Custom DNS servers?
parameters.help: Leave empty for Azure DNS. A hub resolver must resolve the privatelink zones.

parameters.question: Hub virtual network to peer with?
parameters.help: Leave empty for a standalone spoke. The hub side of the peering is not managed here.

parameters.question: Give session hosts outbound internet through a NAT gateway?
parameters.help: New subnets have no default outbound access. Say no only when a hub firewall handles egress, and give its IP next.

parameters.question: Hub firewall IP for outbound traffic?
parameters.help: Only without the NAT gateway: session host internet traffic gets a default route to this firewall. Peering alone doesn't send it there.

parameters.question: Which Entra groups hold the AVD users?
parameters.help: They get the desktop, sign-in to the hosts and their own profile container.

parameters.question: Which Entra groups hold the AVD admins?
parameters.help: Admin sign-in to the hosts, profile admin and read access to the break-glass credential.

parameters.question: How many session hosts?
parameters.help: Autoscale starts and stops them; this is the most that can run.

parameters.question: Session host VM size?
parameters.help: Memory-optimized E-series suits multi-session hosts. Check vCPU quota for its family first.

parameters.question: Most users on one host?
parameters.help: A conservative start; tune it after a load test.

parameters.question: Time zone for the autoscale schedule?
parameters.help: A Windows time zone ID, for example Eastern Standard Time.

parameters.question: Gallery image version from the image pipeline?
parameters.help: Leave empty to use the Windows 11 multi-session with Microsoft 365 marketplace image.

parameters.question: Encrypt session host temp disks and caches at the host?
parameters.help: Needs the Microsoft.Compute/EncryptionAtHost feature on the subscription; the plan stops early, with the command to run, if it isn't registered.

parameters.question: Enroll the hosts in Intune?
parameters.help: Needs Intune licensing and automatic MDM enrollment for the hosts.

parameters.question: Profile share size in GiB?
parameters.help: Premium shares bill on provisioned size; IOPS grow with it.

parameters.question: Workspace name users see?
parameters.help: Shown in the Windows App feed.

parameters.question: Grant autoscale its role on this subscription?
parameters.help: The AVD service principal needs Power On Off Contributor at subscription scope. Only one environment (or the landing zone) per subscription should grant it; say no if one already does.
